# bearmq_exchange (Resource)

An exchange inside a BearMQ virtual host. Every argument forces replacement.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "bearmq_vhost" "orders" {
  name = "orders-prod"
}

# Primary topic exchange.
resource "bearmq_exchange" "orders" {
  vhost_id = bearmq_vhost.orders.id
  name     = "orders"
  type     = "TOPIC"
  durable  = true
}

# Direct dead-letter exchange with a delayed-delivery plugin arg.
resource "bearmq_exchange" "orders_dlx" {
  vhost_id = bearmq_vhost.orders.id
  name     = "orders.dlx"
  type     = "DIRECT"
  durable  = true
  delayed  = true

  args = {
    "alternate-exchange" = "orders.unrouted"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Exchange name, unique within the virtual host.
- `type` (String) Exchange type: `DIRECT`, `FANOUT`, `TOPIC` or `HEADERS` (case-insensitive).
- `vhost_id` (String) ID of the owning virtual host.

### Optional

- `args` (Map of String) Exchange arguments. Not refreshed from the server.
- `delayed` (Boolean) Enable delayed-message delivery. Not refreshed from the server.
- `durable` (Boolean) Survive a broker restart. Defaults to `true`.
- `internal` (Boolean) Internal exchanges accept bindings from other exchanges but reject direct publishes. Defaults to `false`.

### Read-Only

- `actual_name` (String) Internal storage name assigned by BearMQ.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `status` (String) Lifecycle status reported by BearMQ.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Exchanges import as "<vhost_id>/<exchange_id>".
terraform import bearmq_exchange.orders 7f3c1e90-0c2a-4b1d-9f4e-1a2b3c4d5e6f/a1b2c3d4-e5f6-7890-abcd-ef0123456789
```
